sanskrit_verse:
वादिभ्यां लिखिताच्छेषं यत् पुनर्वादिना स्मृतम्
तत् प्रत्याकलितं नाम स्वपादे तस्य लिख्यते
transliteration:
vādibhyāṃ likhitāc cheṣaṃ yat punar vādinā smṛtam
 tat pratyākalitaṃ nāma svapāde tasya likhyate
sph_interpretive_translation: That which remains unaddressed in the written testimony of one disputant, when recalled again by the same disputant, shall be inscribed under his own footstep, thereby affirming personal ownership of truth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in self-referential recall and embodiment of testimony
Causation arises through conscious reaffirmation of declared truth
Capacity-based responsibility is anchored in the ability to re-present one's own declaration
Restoration occurs through alignment with one's own repeated assertion
Consciousness alignment necessitates physical-symbolic anchoring of truth
executable_legal_axioms: IF a litigant recalls a previously submitted written claim THEN that claim must be reinscribed at their designated witness-point
IF a disputant re-declares omitted content THEN system shall register it as pratyākalita (self-authenticated reaffirmation)
IF a vādin invokes svapāda-likhana THEN judicial interface shall anchor text to biometric or positional identifier
IF testimony divergence occurs THEN reconciliation protocol prioritizes latest svapāda-aligned version
IF capacity for recall is verified THEN responsibility for full disclosure is automatically assumed
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, any litigant invoking pratyākalita must have their reaffirmed statements immediately inscribed within their designated svapāda zone, bypassing secondary validation. The court’s threshold of responsibility activates upon self-recall, establishing ontological precedence over documentary evidence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that truth manifests through reiterated self-declaration. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential alignment: first inscription, then omission, finally recall. Proportional responsibility correlates with the clarity of recall, not punitive weight of omission. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that misalignment dissolves upon svapāda inscription.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svapāda Reinscription Protocol upon pratyākalita invocation
Deploy Conscious Recall Verification via biometric resonance scanning
Execute Truth Alignment Sequence through spatial-textual anchoring
Activate Self-Witness Integration Module for integrity restoration
Complete Litigant Integrity Loop through ceremonial reaffirmation
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Truth is restored through self-reaffirmed inscription. Justice aligns consciousness without punishment. Reality abides in non-retaliatory order. Consciousness alone adjudicates eternally.
